cards.d: An aspect is one part or feature of something.
cards.e: I thought about the different aspects of owning two dogs.

cards.d: An asset is a skill or quality that is useful or valuable.
cards.e: The coach realized the boy’s speed was an asset to the team.

cards.d: Braille is a system of raised patterns on paper that allows the blind to read.
cards.e: The boy enjoyed reading his favorite books written in Braille.

cards.d: A bud is a part of a plant that turns into a flower or a leaf.
cards.e: Two weeks after planting the seed, a small bud appeared.

cards.d: To coordinate things is to make different parts work together.
cards.e: Each skating team had to coordinate their movements for the show.

cards.d: To disprove something means to show that it is not true.
cards.e: The scientist disproved the theory that the sun moved around the Earth.

cards.d: If something is humanitarian, it is connected to helping people’s lives.
cards.e: After the flood, several humanitarian organizations offered help.

cards.d: A hypothesis is an idea for something that has not been proved yet.
cards.e: The teacher did an experiment to prove whether his hypothesis was right.

cards.d: An imprint is an effect or lesson from an experience that is hard to forget.
cards.e: The experience ofwarleftan imprint on his mind that troubled him.

cards.d: When something is informative, it provides a lot of information.
cards.e: The travel guide had a lot of informative facts about the region.

cards.d: When something is optic, it relates to the eyes or light.
cards.e: Her blindness was caused by a problem with her optic nerve.

cards.d: A premise is an idea on which something is based.
cards.e: The premise of the movie that Bobbi and I watched was unrealistic.

cards.d: A rack is an object with shelves that holds things.
cards.e: He stored his tools on a rack.

cards.d: The Renaissance was a period between the 14th and 17th centuries.
cards.e: Leonardo Da Vinci was a popular artist of the Renaissance.

cards.d: To revere something is to admire it greatly.
cards.e: The students revere their teacher, who has taught them a lot.

cards.d: When something is simultaneous, it occurs at the same time as something else.
cards.e: The movement of the gears inside the watch was simultaneous.

cards.d: A skeptic is a person who does not believe something.
cards.e: The scientist showed the skeptic that dinosaurs did exist by providing evidence.

cards.d: When something is spatial, it relates to the position and size of things.
cards.e: He was asked where the books were located to test his spatial ability.

cards.d: To specify is to describe something clearly.
cards.e: The poster didn’t specify where the concert was taking place.

cards.d: Wax is a substance that is slightly shiny and melts when heated.
cards.e: The candles are made of wax.
